title: Add A2A per-peer repair report
summary: A2A repair visibility is operator-ready, but delegated repair expansion needs a read-only per-peer report that groups queue and retry evidence without mutating tasks or peer state.
expectedFailureModes: Operators cannot see which peer owns stale in-flight repair risk before delegated repair expands.
Retry-stale reports aggregate skipped unsafe tasks without peer grouping, hiding peer-specific failures.
Repair visibility can be marked delegated-ready before peer-mismatched denial coverage exists.
nextAction: Add a read-only A2A peer repair report over exported status and retry JSON, wire it into repair visibility validation, and update docs/status while delegated repair denial coverage remains blocked.
